notes.title: Update: 0.2.1
notes.content:
New update available!
What's new:
- Queue based multithreading architecture
- Improve blending with float 16/32 framebuffer
- Use tick icon on checkboxes
- Improved battery life
- Improve file browser thumbnails
- Unique recovery file name
- Layers sorted from top to bottom
- Limit camera zoom
- Add clipboard support on Android
- Add UI and Viewport scale options
- Add shortcut to rotate canvas with spacebar

And many bugs fixed:
- Fix bucket fill tool
- Fix stroke samples computation
- Fix PPI file association on OSX and iOS
- Fix color bleeding due to interpolation
- Fix layer index on undo/redo
- Fix Import image aliasing
- Fix color picking tool
- Fix color from clipboard update global
- Fix VR stroke rendering
- Fix hard-mix stroke shader
- Fix brush outline on scaled viewport
- Fix UI on iOS device rotation
- Fix exporting

notes.title: Update 0.1.9.745 is live!
notes.content:
This new update has a lot of bugs fixed and improvements.
The main focus has been on the Undo/Redo feature, fixing most of the history related bugs. 
Now you can Undo all the layers related actions as well as the perspective guides. 
You can create, delete and move guides.
3D depth export has been fixed.

notes.title: [0.1.9.721] VR Interface Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 
the VR update 721 now enables the interaction with the user interface. You can finally use almost all the features that are supported in VR.
The grids and heightmaps are still in progress and there's not virtual keyboard yet, so you need to input from a keyboard.

Interaction:
You can interact with the UI by pressing the B button on the Oculus or the touchpad button on the Vive controller.
You can then see a cursor that come from a ray casted forward from the controller.
The mouse click is simulated with the trigger button on the controller.

Painting:
For painting the controller position is used to paint directly on the cubical canvas, you can use the trigger force to drive the brush pressure.

Happy painting.
